icu.reason: Hypotension, tachypnoea and rising lactate on post-operative day 6

possible_causes.why: New oxygen need and bibasal crackles; CXR pending
No current cytotoxic treatment; bevacizumab stopped before surgery

follow_up.subject: ICU admission update: Emil Schneider (synthetic MRN 00000056)
follow_up.draft:
Dear Dr. Keller,

Mr Schneider was admitted to ICU at 02:40 from surgical ward 7C with septic shock on post-operative day 6 after right hemicolectomy. The ICU team reviewed the Onco-ICU summary: metastatic colorectal cancer with prior partial response, systemic therapy planned after recovery, and no active cytotoxic treatment this week. Main reversible concern is intra-abdominal sepsis; CT abdomen and cultures are pending.

Treatment wishes: the clinic note records that he would accept ICU treatment for reversible complications while oncological options remain. We could not find a signed ACP/treatment-limitation document in the ICU chart, so please confirm with his spouse and oncology team in the morning.

Current ICU actions: norepinephrine started, broad-spectrum antibiotics given, surgical review requested, and ventilation plan discussed with the intensivist. We will update you after imaging and source-control decision.

Kind regards,
ICU night team
